import os,re,numpy as np,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    axis,pos,val=None,None,None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg: axis,pos,val='R',r,g[r][0]; break
    if axis is None:
        for c in range(w):
            vs={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(vs)==1 and next(iter(vs))!=bg: axis,pos,val='C',c,next(iter(vs)); break
    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=val]
    if axis=='R':
        mv=min(r for r,c in cells); mx=max(r for r,c in cells)
        if pos > mx:   d=pos-1-mx          # separator right of object: move right toward it
        elif pos < mv: d=pos+1-mv
        else:          d=0
        nmv, nmx = mv+d, mx+d
        L = nmv-1 if pos>mx   else nmx+1       # 8-line on far side of bbox from sep
        for r,c in cells: out[r+d][c]=g[r][c]; out[r][c]=bg
        for c in range(w):
            if 0<=L<h: out[L][c]=8
    else:
        mv=min(c for r,c in cells); mx=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if pos > mx:   d=pos-1-mx          # separator below/right
        elif pos < mv: d=pos+1-mv
        else:          d=0
        nmv, nmx = mv+d, mx+d
        L = nmv-1 if pos>mx   else nmx+1
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+d]=g[r][c]; out[r][c]=bg
        for r in range(h):
            if 0<=L<w: out[r][L]=8
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    o=np.array(G[k+' output']); q=np.array(f(G[k+' input']))
    print(k, np.array_equal(q,o))
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

        L=nmx+1 if pos>mx else nmv-1

from collections import Counter
import json
def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    if sep_rows: axis=pos_r=sep_rows[0]; val=g[pos_r][0]
    else:         axis=pos_c=sep_cols[0]; val=g[0][pos_c]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=val]
    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    if axis=='R':
        mv=min(r for r,c in cells); mx=max(r for r,c in cells)
        if pos_r>mx:  d=pos_r-mx-1; nmv,nmx=mv+d,mx+d; L=nmv-1   # far side = top
        elif pos_r<mv:d=pos_r+1-mv; nmv,nmx=mv+d,mx+d; L=nmx+1
        else:         nmv,nmx=mv,mx;     L=None
        for r,c in cells: out[r+d][c]=g[r][c]
        if L is not None:
            for c in range(w): out[L][c]=8

        mv=min(c for r,c in cells); mx=max(c for r,c in cells)

        else:         L=None
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+d]=g[r][c]
        if L is not None:
            for r in range(h): out[r][L]=8
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    q=f(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']
    diffs=[(r,c,q[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if q[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
    print(k,'match' if not diffs else diffs[:6])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])

    sep=None; axis=None; pos=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg: sep=r; axis='R'; pos=r; v=g[r][0]

        for c in range(w):
            if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg: sep=c; axis='C'; pos=c; v=g[0][c]
    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=v]
    if axis=='R':
        mv=min(r for r,c in cells); mx=max(r for r,c in cells)
        if pos<mv:   d=pos+1-mv; nmv,nmx=mv+d,mx+d; L=nmx+1
        elif pos>mx: d=pos-1-mx; nmv,nmx=mv+d,mx+d; L=nmv-1
        else:         d=0; nmv,nmx=mv,mx; L=nmx+1
        for r,c in cells: out[r+d][c]=g[r][c]
        if L>=0 and L<h:
            for c in range(w): out[L][c]=8
    else:
        mv=min(c for r,c in cells); mx=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if pos<mv:   d=pos+1-mv; nmv,nmx=mv+d,mx+d; L=nmx+1
        elif pos>mx: d=pos-1-mx; nmv,nmx=mv+d,mx+d; L=nmv-1
        else:         d=0; nmv,nmx=mv,mx; L=nmx+1
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+d]=g[r][c]
        if L>=0 and L<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][L]=8
    return out

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=None; axis=None; pos=None; v=None
    # find first full uniform line whose color differs from background
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg:
            sep=r; axis='R'; pos=r; v=g[r][0]; break
    if sep is None:
        for c in range(w):
            s={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(s)==1 and g[0][c]!=bg:
                sep=c; axis='C'; pos=c; v=list(s)[0]; break
    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=v]
    if axis=='R':
        mm=min(r for r,c in cells); mx=max(r for r,c in cells)
        if pos<mx or pos<mm: pass
        if pos<=mm:   # separator above object
            d=pos+1-mm
        elif pos>=mx: # below
            d=pos-1-mx
        else:         # inside bbox -> treat as touching: slide until edge touches
            d=0
        nnm,nnx = mm+d,mx+d
        L = (nnx+1) if d>0 and pos<mm else ((nnm-1) if d<0 else None)
        for r,c in cells: out[r+d][c]=g[r][c]
        if L is not None and 0<=L<h:
            for c in range(w): out[L][c]=8
    else:
        mm=min(c for r,c in cells); mx=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if pos<=mm: d=pos+1-mm
        elif pos>=mx: d=pos-1-mx
        else: d=0
        L=(mx+d)+1 if d>0 and pos<mm else (mm+d)-1 if d<0 else None
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+d]=g[r][c]
        if L is not None and 0<=L<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][L]=8
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    q=f(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match' if q==o else [(r,c,q[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if q[r][c]!=o[r][c]][:8])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find separator
    sep=None;axis=pos=v=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg: axis,pos,v='R',r,g[r][0]; break
    if axis is None:
        for c in range(w):
            s={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(s)==1 and g[0][c]!=bg: axis,pos,v='C',c,s.pop(); break
    # collect object cells (not bg, not sep)
    obj=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=v]
    mn=max(mx for mx,_ in [x for x in obj]); mn_ = min(r for r,c in obj)
    if axis=='R':
        mm=min(c for r,c in obj); mx_=max(c for r,c in obj)
        # slide toward separator
        dr = pos - (mx_+1)  # target top so that bottom touches pos
        out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
        # clear orig
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r+dr][c]=g[r][c]
        far = mn_-1 if dr>=0 else mn_+(-mn_)
        # far side: opposite of dr sign relative to separator
        lo,hi = min(r for r,c in obj), max(r for r,c in obj)
        if dr>0: lo_r,hi_r = hi+1,h
        else: lo_r,hi_r = 0,lo-1
        for r in range(lo_r,hi_r+1):
            for c in range(w): out[r][c]=8
    else:
        mm=min(c for r,c in obj); mx_=max(c for r,c in obj)
        dc = pos - (mx_+1)
        out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c+dc]=g[r][c]
        lo,hi=min(c for r,c in obj),max(c for r,c in obj)
        if dc>0: lo_c,hi_c = hi+1,w
        else: lo_c,hi_c = 0,lo-1
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(lo_c,hi_c+1): out[r][c]=8
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    axis=pos=v=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg: axis,pos,v='R',r,g[r][0]; break
    if axis is None:
        for c in range(w):
            s={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(s)==1 and g[0][c]!=bg: axis,pos,v='C',c,s.pop(); break
    obj=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=v]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    if axis=='R':
        rs=[r for r,c in obj]; mn,mx=min(rs),max(rs)
        dr = pos-(mx+1) if mx+1 <= pos else pos-(mn)-1
        # clear original
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r+dr][c]=g[r][c]
        lo,hi=mn,mx
        lo_c,hi_c=(hi+1,w-1) if dr>=0 else (0,lo-1)
        for c in range(lo_c,hi_c+1):
            for r in range(h): out[r][c]=8
    else:
        cs=[c for r,c in obj]; mn,mx=min(cs),max(cs)
        dc = pos-(mx+1) if mx+1 <= pos else pos-(mn)-1
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c+dc]=g[r][c]
        lo,hi=mn,mx
        lo_r,hi_r=(hi+1,h-1) if dc>=0 else (0,lo-1)
        for r in range(lo_r,hi_r+1):
            for c in range(w): out[r][c]=8
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    p=f(gi)
    print(k,'match' if p==go else 'MISMATCH')

        for c in range(w):
            sc={gi[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(sc)==1 and list(sc)[0]!=bg: sep=c; ax='v'; break
    res=[r[:] for r in gi]
    ocells=[]

def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=None;ax=None;sepval=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(gi[r]))==1 and gi[r][0]!=bg: sep=r; ax='h'; sepval=gi[r][0]; break
    if sep is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if len({gi[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and gi[0][c]!=bg: sep=c; ax='v'; sepval=gi[0][c]; break
    res=[r[:] for r in gi]
    sepcol=sepval
    obj={(r,c):gi[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=bg and gi[r][c]!=sepcol}
    out={}
    if ax=='h':
        rs=[r for r,c in obj]
        if min(rs)>sep:      d=-1; near=min(rs); dist=min(rs)-sep-1
        else:                d=1; near=max(rs); dist=sep-max(rs)-1
        for (r,c),v in obj.items(): out[(r+dist*d,c)]=v
        far = max(rs)+dist*d if d==-1 else min(rs)+dist*d
        for c in range(w): res[far][c]=8
    else:
        cs=[c for r,c in obj]
        if min(cs)>sep:      dc=min(cs)-sep-1
        else:                dc=sep-max(cs)-1
        for (r,c),v in obj.items(): out[(r,c+dc)]=v
        far = max(cs)+dc if min(cs)>sep else min(cs)+dc
        for r in range(h): res[r][far]=8
    final=[r[:] for r in res]
    for (r,c),v in out.items(): final[r][c]=v
    return final
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=None;ax=None;sepval=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(gi[r]))==1 and gi[r][0]!=bg: sep=r; ax='h'; sepval=gi[r][0]; break
    if sep is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if len({gi[x][c] for x in range(h)})==1 and gi[0][c]!=bg: sep=c; ax='v'; sepval=gi[0][c]; break
    res=[r[:] for r in gi]
    obj={(r,c):gi[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=bg and gi[r][c]!=sepval}
    out={}
    if ax=='h':
        cs=[c for r,c in obj]
        if min(cs)<sep:      # object left of sep
            dc=sep-1-max(cs)          # slide right to touch
            for (r,c),v in obj.items(): out[(r,c+dc)]=v
            mn=min(cs)+dc; mx=max(cs)+dc
            far=mn-1                  # beyond left edge
            for c in range(w): res[far][c]=8
        else:                 # object right of sep
            dc=min(cs)-sep-1          # slide left to touch
            for (r,c),v in obj.items(): out[(r,c+dc)]=v
            mn=min(cs)+dc; mx=max(cs)+dc
            far=mx+1                 # beyond right edge
            for c in range(w): res[far][c]=8
    else:
        rs=[r for r,c in obj]
        if min(rs)<sep:        # object above sep
            dr=sep-1-max(rs)     # slide down to touch
            for (r,c),v in obj.items(): out[(r+dr,c)]=v
            mn=min(rs)+dr; mx=max(rs)+dr
            far=mn-1             # beyond top edge
            for c in range(h): res[c][far]=8
        else:                  # object below sep
            dr=min(rs)-sep-1     # slide up to touch
            for (r,c),v in obj.items(): out[(r+dr,c)]=v
            mn=min(rs)+dr; mx=max(rs)+dr
            far=mx+1             # beyond bottom edge
            for c in range(h): res[c][far]=8
    final=[r[:] for r in res]
    for (r,c),v in out.items(): final[r][c]=v
    return final
